title: Bounded-torsion projective-line direct images vanish above degree two
statement:
For every scheme S and abelian etale sheaf F on P1_S killed by a positive integer N, R^q(P1_S to S)_*F is zero when q>2. Use torsion cohomological dimension as in [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], the strict localization as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] when it occurs, and Krull dimension as in [def-kun-dimension]. The following verbatim Lean statement specifies all universes, hypotheses, scalar structures, sheaves and degrees:

theorem isZero_rightDerived_projectiveLine_of_killed_by
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine S).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hF : N • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 < q) :
    IsZero (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).rightDerived q).obj F)

source.place: Projective-line row above degree two; cycle-free geometric-stalk proof

proof.text: Regard abelian sheaves as ULift-integer module sheaves using the existing exact forgetful equivalence. The uniform annihilator is preserved and reflected.

At every algebraic-closure geometric point of S, the projective-line geometric-stalk comparison identifies the higher image stalk with cohomology on the geometric projective line. The existing source curve bound makes that cohomology zero above degree two.

Geometric points detect zero. The exact coefficient-forgetting/direct-image comparison and both exact derived-composition isomorphisms transfer the zero higher-image sheaf back to abelian coefficients.
